observations: Two power banks lying on a concrete floor, poor lighting.
One power bank is wrapped in tape/cloth over most of its body, obscuring any label or ports.
The other power bank shows a dark plastic casing with scratches and scuff marks, no visible brand text or model number.
Green and blue fabric-braided cables are coiled near the power banks, likely charging/USB cables.
No screen, LED indicator, capacity label, or port detail is visible on either unit.
Photo has a 'Shot on AWESOME A70' watermark, indicating the capturing phone, not the item.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows worn, taped-up units consistent with 'scrap' framing, but no power-on, charging, or output test is shown to confirm they are non-functional versus merely used.

risks.risk: Internal battery cells could be swollen, leaking, or unsafe, which affects resale/parts value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of each unit opened or at least unwrapped, showing the cell casing condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as scrap/for-parts only, not as a usable power bank

risks.risk: Actual capacity (mAh) and output specs are unknown since no label is visible.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating label/sticker on each unit, if one exists under the tape.
risks.if_unproven: priced without any capacity premium, i.e. generic scrap value

risks.risk: Cables shown may or may not be included in the sale, and their functional state is unverified.
risks.proof: Seller confirms in writing whether cables are included, plus a photo of cable tips/connectors for damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as power banks only, cables treated as condition-unknown extras with no added value

risks.risk: Units could be non-chargeable or completely dead (seller's own 'scrap' label suggests this), which is the base assumption already.
risks.proof: Video of each unit connected to a charger showing any LED/charging response.

proof_requests: A video showing each power bank plugged into a charger or output device to test any sign of life.
A close-up of any rating label (mAh, model) if present under the tape or casing.
Confirmation of what exactly is included in the sale (both power banks, cables, or just one lot).
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable by type as used/scrap power banks with no model or brand legible, and the seller's own description as 'scrap' supports pricing them at worst-case non-working/for-parts value without needing further proof to set a floor price.
